name: Nalu Vida
facts: Nalu Vida is at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier.
Phone: (310) 437-0060. Email: info@naluvida.com. Instagram: @naluvidavenice.

qa.q: How do I join Nalu Vida Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free. Open the Rewards section in the app and sign up, one account per person.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?

qa.q: Do I get a bonus for joining?
qa.a: Yes, +100 points once when you join.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip). You can also earn a join bonus, a birthday bonus, referral points and game points.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap 'Add my visit' in the app and snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday).

qa.q: Are there limits on adding a visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.
Once our Toast system is connected, adding visits will be automatic and your points carry over.

qa.q: What can I get for 250 points?

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap 'Use reward' on the reward you want and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. A used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, with no stacking. A second one that day shows 'Come back tomorrow'.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.
Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. We may change the program or rewards with notice in the app.

qa.q: Can I transfer my points or cash out rewards?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.
No levels or tiers. It's one simple points balance and one rewards ladder.
Yes, +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How do I enter a friend's referral code?

qa.q: Is there an early-bird or location bonus?

qa.q: Can I add the card to Apple or Google Wallet?

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use 'Add to Home Screen'. On iPhone tap Share then 'Add to Home Screen'. On Android tap the menu and 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install'.

qa.q: I have a membership already. How do I sign back in?
qa.a: If your phone number is already a member, the app will offer to sign you back in on this phone. You get one account per person.

qa.q: Can I get texts about deals?
qa.a: When you join there's an optional, unchecked 'Text me deals' box. It's your choice, and you can reply STOP to opt out.
A free surf game with 5 levels on the Venice Pier loop: paddle out, grab food rafts, then ride the wave home. You earn Rewards points from your score.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. It's free to play with or without an account, and no purchase is necessary.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. Paddling out, tap DUCK DIVE under each breaking wave. Riding in, stay off the white foam, tap JUMP to launch off the lip, then do a trick and land it.
Drag to steer, tap DUCK DIVE (JUMP) for waves, tap JUMP or swipe up to launch, then TRICK or swipe in the air: sideways is a 360, down is a grab, up is a flip.
Steer past stingrays and a fisherman's stray harpoons, and tap DUCK DIVE as each breaking wave reaches you. Duck-diving under a wave scores +100.

qa.q: How do I ride the wave in?
qa.a: Stay on the clean face and out of the white foam. Tap JUMP to ride up the lip and launch, then do a trick and land it for NICE!

Food rafts score +100 to +150 (Island Tacos +100, Mimosa and Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack and Coconut Shrimp +150). Duck-dives give +100, barrel exits +200, and you also score for time in the pocket.
Grab 4 in a row for x2, 8 in a row for x3, and so on. A hit resets your streak.

qa.q: What hurts me in the game?
qa.a: You have 5 hearts, lost in halves. White foam, stingrays and bumping into sea life cost you, and landing mid-trick is a small bail (-150). It's a mild splash wipeout, never anything scary.
Level 1 is about 2 minutes (30 s paddle-out, 90 s ride). Later levels have shorter paddle-outs. Finish all 5 for a big finish bonus.

qa.q: How many game points can I earn?
qa.a: Every 100 score is 1 Nalu Vida Rewards point, up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date).

qa.q: Can I play as much as I want?
qa.a: Yes, games are free to play for fun and score. Only game points are capped at 50 a day.

qa.q: I'm not a member. Do I lose my game points?
qa.a: No. Your points from today are held on your phone. Join the same day to save them.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The weekly board is for bragging rights only and resets every Monday. Last week's top 3 show on the champions card in the app.

qa.q: Who is the weekly champion and what do they win?
qa.a: Last week's top 3 are shown on the champions card with a countdown to when this week's board closes (Sunday 11 PM). The game itself gives no prizes, codes or discounts.

qa.q: Does the game give prizes or discounts?
qa.a: No. The game only turns your score into Rewards points, and the weekly board is for bragging rights.
The game has no weekly prizes. The board closes Sunday 11 PM and resets Monday, just for bragging rights.

qa.q: Is there a hidden bonus in the game?
qa.a: Yes! A billboard buoy floats by the pier once a run. Ride through it for a +500 bonus and a link to Antidote's food review of Nalu Vida.

qa.q: Why did a video play between levels?
qa.a: That's a short halftime break with Antidote The Foodie's review of Nalu Vida. You can skip it or watch the full review.

qa.q: Can I change the music or graphics?
qa.a: Yes, in game settings. You can pick the song (Cheat Code or Xtreme Rich Person), Graphics, Weather and Time of day, and turn the 3D graphics (beta) on or off.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes, controllers work in most browsers. Pair one, press any button, and use the stick or D-pad to steer. Select opens the controller help.

qa.q: Which table numbers can I pick?
